description: Simulates a blockchain reorganization attack where an adversary mines a private chain and releases it to orphan previously-confirmed transactions, enabling double-spending by exploiting probabilistic finality.
mitigation_target: Probabilistic Finality Threshold, Checkpointing, Slashing, Committee Finality

execution_phases.name: public_chain_advancement
execution_phases.description: Public chain mines blocks 1-8, establishing baseline

execution_phases.name: adversary_private_mining
execution_phases.description: Adversary mines private chain starting from block 8, withholding from network

execution_phases.name: public_chain_continues
execution_phases.description: Public chain continues mining blocks 9-15, unaware of private chain

execution_phases.name: adversary_transaction_on_public
execution_phases.description: Adversary submits payment transaction to public chain, gets confirmations

execution_phases.name: reorg_release
execution_phases.description: Adversary releases private chain, causing network reorganization

execution_phases.name: double_spend_completion
execution_phases.description: Adversary now has goods and retains original funds, can double-spend

execution_phases.name: system_recovery
execution_phases.description: System recovers from reorg, re-establishes consensus on new chain

attack_vectors.name: Private Chain Mining
attack_vectors.description: Adversary mines private chain with sufficient hash power to eventually overtake public chain

attack_vectors.name: Confirmation Window Exploitation
attack_vectors.description: Adversary waits for victim transaction to receive confirmations but not reach finality threshold

attack_vectors.name: Economic Extraction Timing
attack_vectors.description: Adversary extracts value from confirmed transactions before reorg invalidates them

invariant_checks.description: Total value in system remains constant across reorg
No address spends same funds twice successfully

critical: Off-chain value extraction before reorg detection
medium: Reorg depth of 7 blocks causes significant disruption
